name: Skipper Tammie

intro.text: I fish for whitefish and for langoustine, out past Bressay. Up at four, back by lunch, in a mood by six. Fancy a battle? It beats the quota.

win: Right, fair enough. I'll make the tea.
after: A boat in Shetland is called a 'yoal' if it's small and a 'sixareen' if it's big. The sixareen has six oars and a fierce crew. The mood in the boat is that of a very long walk.
